A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
